edges.notes: vhost is a Linux kernel framework for virtio backends documented in the kernel tree.
vhost accelerates virtio virtqueue handling on the host; virtio defines the guest/device contract.
KVM guests using virtio devices may pair with vhost backends on the host; KVM is the hypervisor API, vhost is the I/O path.
Host datapaths for Firecracker’s virtio devices may involve vhost-class mechanisms depending on configuration and kernel.
QEMU can configure vhost backends for virtio datapaths depending on device and command line.
